note: Baseline for comparing the intent split and the office-page indexing work. Pulled from the Search Console and Bing Webmaster APIs on the capture date; Search Console reports final data with a 2-3 day lag, so the last day of the current window is incomplete. Do not replace these numbers with a later estimate: add a new dated block instead.

dataCompleteness.note: The 24 November row is partial and 25 November had not been reported when the baseline was pulled.

crawlRecency.note: Googlebot had not fetched the homepage for 18 days when this was recorded, while Bing crawled it daily. Every change made after 7 November is therefore invisible to Google, including the office pages, the intent split and the split sitemap. The impressions in the current window come from the 7 November snapshot.

indexing.note: The registered sitemap was still the pre-split urlset, and every sampled non-homepage URL returned 'URL is unknown to Google'. That is a discovery state, not a canonical or ranking problem.

officeQueries.query: irish embassy new delhi visa decisions

officeQueryOwnership.note: Every query/page pair in the window resolved to the homepage. No office URL registered a single impression.

bing.note: Bing crawled 15 pages on 23 November and held 12 in its index on 24 November, with no search performance rows for 11-23 November.

google.action: sitemap resubmission through the Search Console API

googleRequestIndexing.note: Request indexing is a signed-in Search Console action. The eight-URL queue is listed in docs/search-console.md.
